title: wildfire-bc-bilstm-pso: Geospatial Deep Learning and SHAP-Based Explanation for Wildfire Susceptibility and Exposure Assessment in Western Canada
description:
Code, derived data, trained model weights, and standards-compliant metadata supporting Khan et al. (2026), Ecological Informatics (ECOINF-D-26-01275).

Contents: BiLSTM and BiLSTM-PSO modelling pipeline; processed wildfire and non-fire point dataset; conditioning-factor and susceptibility rasters; per-model probability tables; trained Keras weights; SHAP explanation outputs; spatial block cross-validation; figure and table generation scripts.

Metadata: ISO 19115-2 XML for every derived raster, W3C CSVW (JSON-LD) dictionaries for every tabular dataset, and SHA-256 checksums for all files.

Coordinate reference system: NAD83 / BC Albers (EPSG:3005), 1500 m grid.

Licensing: record licence MIT (code); code MIT; author-generated derived data CC-BY 4.0. Third-party input datasets are NOT redistributed; each is documented with provider, access link and licence in DATA_SOURCES.md.
notes: AUTHOR INPUT REQUIRED: supply ORCIDs for Khan, Al-Mughrabi, Malekian, Esau and Uz Zaman (Farooque and Wang verified from record 10.5281/zenodo.20820293). After acceptance, add the article DOI as a related_identifier with relation 'isSupplementTo'.
